judged_text: The loading view reloads every 30 seconds unconditionally with no terminal failure state, even when retrieval can never succeed. When fetch_http bails (embed_by_username unset or user not found), TopicRetriever's host check rejects the URL, the throttle blocks the retry, or import fails, the embedded iframe shows 'Loading Discussion...' and re-requests /embed/best (enqueuing a retrieve job each time) forever on the publisher's page — an infinite reload loop with no error surfaced to the embedding site.

adjudication.rationale: In the new embed flow, when no TopicEmbed exists (`EmbedController#best`), the controller always enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `embed/loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading template unconditionally reloads the iframe every 30s via `document.location.reload()` (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb) with no terminal/error state. If retrieval never creates a TopicEmbed (e.g., `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` returns early when `embed_by_username` is unset or user not found, or `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` rejects `@embed_url`, or other failures), `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` will continue to return nil and the iframe will loop forever, repeatedly hitting `/embed/best` and re-enqueuing jobs on each reload. The 60s redis throttle only affects the job’s internal retrieval, not the controller’s repeated enqueues/reloads, so the “infinite loading loop with no error surfaced” is a real behavior implied by this diff.
